meta.description: Visual and architectural descriptions of 30 Hanoi landmarks for GLiNER / GLiNER-Relex extraction
meta.entity_labels_used: Visual entity vocab (35 labels) from Module 2
meta.relation_labels_used: Visual & spatial relation labels from Module 4; 'leading to' -> connects, 'stands on' -> situated_on, 'contains' -> has_part

landmarks.name_vi: Quảng trường Ba Đình (Quần thể Lăng Bác)
landmarks.category: Quảng trường & Di tích quốc gia

visual_descriptions.overview: Ba Dinh Square is a vast open landmark located in Ba Dinh district of Hanoi. The square is covered with a grid of green lawn plots separated by paved walkways, with a tall flagpole carrying the red national flag standing in the center. The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum faces the square from the west side.
visual_descriptions.architecture: The Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum is a monumental mausoleum made of grey granite with a flat roof and a portico of square stone columns. The mausoleum stands on a stepped stone platform and has a solemn modernist architectural style. Above the entrance, the inscription 'Chu tich Ho Chi Minh' is set in dark red stone.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: The square is surrounded by trees and government buildings, including the yellow Presidential Palace with a French colonial architectural style. The One Pillar Pagoda and the Ho Chi Minh Museum are located near the mausoleum. Honor guards in white uniforms often stand in front of the mausoleum entrance.

landmarks.name_vi: Làng gốm Bát Tràng
landmarks.category: Làng nghề truyền thống

visual_descriptions.overview: Bat Trang Pottery Village is a traditional craft village located in Gia Lam district, on the bank of the Red River. Narrow alleys lead between old brick houses, pottery workshops and shops displaying glazed ceramic vases, bowls and jars in blue, white and brown colors.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Many old houses in the village are made of fired brick and have tiled roofs, and some walls are lined with round coal cakes drying in the sun. Inside the workshops, traditional brick kilns stand with chimneys, and rows of unfired clay pots sit on wooden shelves. The Bat Trang Communal House is a traditional communal house with a curved tiled roof and wooden columns.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: The Bat Trang Ceramic Museum is a modern building with terraced curved forms inspired by the shape of a potter's wheel. The village market is surrounded by stalls with ceramic products, and visitors sit at potter's wheels to shape clay. The Red River dyke runs along the edge of the village.

landmarks.name_vi: Vườn Bách Thảo Hà Nội
landmarks.category: Công viên & Cảnh quan

visual_descriptions.overview: The Hanoi Botanical Garden is a large green park located in Ba Dinh district, behind the Presidential Palace. Shaded walkways run under tall old trees, and a quiet lake with a small island lies inside the garden. A small hill covered with trees rises near the lake, and lawns are surrounded by flower beds and stone benches.

visual_descriptions.overview: Dien Hong Park is a small triangular urban garden located near Hoan Kiem Lake. The garden is shaded by large old trees and has paved paths and benches. It is surrounded by French colonial buildings with yellow facades, including the Government Guest House and the Hanoi People's Committee building.

landmarks.name_vi: Gò Đống Đa (Tượng đài Quang Trung)
landmarks.category: Di tích lịch sử chiến thắng

visual_descriptions.overview: Dong Da Mound is a historical park located in Dong Da district. A large bronze statue of Emperor Quang Trung stands on a high stone pedestal, holding a sword and facing the open plaza. The grass-covered mound rises behind the statue, and the park is surrounded by trees, with a small temple and a lake nearby.

landmarks.name_vi: Ga Hà Nội (Ga Hàng Cỏ)
landmarks.category: Công trình kiến trúc giao thông

visual_descriptions.overview: Ha Noi Station is a railway station building located on Le Duan street. The central block has a modern concrete facade with the name 'GA HA NOI' in large red letters on top. The two side wings keep the original French colonial architectural style with yellow walls and arched windows, and a busy forecourt with motorbikes faces the main entrance.

landmarks.name_vi: Không gian Ẩm thực Hà Nội
landmarks.category: Di sản văn hóa ẩm thực

visual_descriptions.overview: Hanoi Cuisine scenes show street food stalls on narrow sidewalks of the Old Quarter, with diners sitting on low plastic stools around small tables. Steaming bowls of pho with white rice noodles, green herbs and red chili are served beside baskets of fresh vegetables. Shop fronts are lit by yellow light and colorful signboards, with motorbikes parked along the street.

landmarks.name_vi: Bảo tàng Hà Nội (Kim tự tháp ngược)
landmarks.category: Bảo tàng hiện đại

visual_descriptions.overview: The Hanoi Museum is a modern museum located on Pham Hung street in Nam Tu Liem district. The building has the shape of an inverted pyramid, with each upper floor wider than the floor below. Its facade is made of glass and grey metal panels, and the museum is surrounded by water features, lawns and a wide plaza.

landmarks.name_vi: Phố cổ Hà Nội (36 phố phường)
landmarks.category: Khu phố di sản đô thị

visual_descriptions.overview: The Hanoi Old Quarter is a dense historic district located north of Hoan Kiem Lake. Narrow streets are lined with tall, thin tube houses and shophouses, many with small balconies, wooden shutters and colorful signboards. Tangled electrical cables hang above streets crowded with motorbikes and street vendors.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Older tube houses have low tiled roofs made of red clay tiles, while French-era shophouses have yellow plastered walls and green wooden shutters. The Ma May Ancient House is a traditional wooden house with an inner courtyard. Bach Ma Temple is a small temple with a curved tiled roof and a red wooden gate.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: O Quan Chuong is the only remaining city gate of the old citadel walls, a brick gate with an arched passage and an upper watchtower. Dong Xuan Market is a large market building with a French colonial facade. Hang Ma street is decorated with red lanterns and colorful paper toys.

landmarks.name_vi: Hồ Hoàn Kiếm (Tháp Rùa - Cầu Thê Húc)
landmarks.category: Thắng cảnh & Trung tâm lịch sử

visual_descriptions.overview: Hoan Kiem Lake is a landmark lake located in the center of Hanoi, with calm green water surrounded by willow trees and old banyan trees. Turtle Tower stands on a small island in the middle of the lake. On the northern part of the lake, the red The Huc Bridge connects the eastern shore to Ngoc Son Temple on Jade Island.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Turtle Tower is a small three-storey tower made of brick and lime, with arched openings and a mixed architectural style combining Vietnamese and French Gothic elements. The Huc Bridge is a curved wooden bridge painted bright red, with red railings. Ngoc Son Temple has curved tiled roofs and wooden pillars, surrounded by old trees.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: Pen Tower is a stone tower situated on a small hill at the temple entrance, with the Ink Slab gate carved in stone beside it. The Le Thai To statue stands on the western shore, facing the lake. Hoa Phong Tower stands on the eastern shore, and the lake is surrounded by walking paths and the streets of the Old Quarter.

landmarks.name_vi: Hồ Hữu Tiệp (Di tích xác máy bay B-52)
landmarks.category: Di tích lịch sử kháng chiến

visual_descriptions.overview: Huu Tiep Lake is a small pond located in a residential alley of Ngoc Ha ward, Ba Dinh district. The rusted metal wreckage of a B-52 bomber rises out of the water, partly covered with plants. The lake is surrounded by houses and a low railing, with a stone memorial plaque on the shore.

landmarks.name_vi: Hoàng Thành Thăng Long
landmarks.category: Di sản văn hóa thế giới

visual_descriptions.overview: The Imperial Citadel of Thang Long is an ancient citadel located in Ba Dinh district, in the center of Hanoi. The main entrance is Doan Mon gate, a massive stone and brick gate with arched passages and an upper pavilion with a curved tiled roof. Inside, a long central axis leads through green lawns and old trees to the foundation of Kinh Thien Palace.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Doan Mon gate has five arched entrances, with the central arch larger than the others, and a wooden pavilion with a double roof above. Kinh Thien Palace foundation keeps the stone dragon steps, with carved dragons running along the stone railing. Hau Lau, the Princess Pavilion, is a multi-storey building with yellow walls and a tiled roof.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: The Hanoi Flag Tower is an octagonal brick tower situated on a three-tiered base, with the red national flag at the top. The North Gate is a brick gate with a curved roof, showing cannonball marks on its wall. Across Hoang Dieu street, the archaeological site reveals ancient foundations, wells and relics under protective roofs.

landmarks.category: Cảnh quan hồ đô thị

visual_descriptions.overview: Ba Mau Lake is an urban lake located in Dong Da district. A paved walking path with a low railing runs around the water, shaded by rows of trees. The lake is surrounded by residential buildings and small cafes along the shore.

landmarks.category: Cảnh quan hồ đô thị

visual_descriptions.overview: Thien Quang Lake is an urban lake located in Hai Ba Trung district, near Thong Nhat Park. Calm water reflects the surrounding trees and buildings, and a paved walkway with a railing runs along the shore. Old trees line the streets around the lake.

landmarks.name_vi: Công viên Lê Nin (Vườn hoa Chi Lăng)
landmarks.category: Công viên & Quảng trường

visual_descriptions.overview: Lenin Park is a small public garden located on Dien Bien Phu street in Ba Dinh district. A bronze statue of Lenin stands on a tall stone pedestal in the center of the garden, facing the Hanoi Flag Tower across the street. The statue is surrounded by an open paved plaza, lawns and trees.

landmarks.name_vi: Làng nghề đúc đồng Ngũ Xã
landmarks.category: Làng nghề truyền thống

visual_descriptions.overview: Ngu Xa is a traditional bronze casting craft village located near Truc Bach Lake in Ba Dinh district. Small workshops and shops display bronze statues, incense burners, bells and trays with a golden brown color. Ngu Xa Pagoda in the village houses a large bronze statue of Amitabha Buddha.

landmarks.name_vi: Chùa Một Cột (Diên Hựu Tự)
landmarks.category: Di tích kiến trúc tâm linh

visual_descriptions.overview: The One Pillar Pagoda is a small pagoda located in Ba Dinh district, near the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum. The wooden shrine stands on a single stone pillar rising from the middle of a square lotus pond. The pagoda is inspired by the image of a lotus flower blooming above the water.
visual_descriptions.architecture: The shrine is a square wooden structure with a curved tiled roof, and dragon figures decorate the ridge of the roof. Wooden brackets connect the shrine to the top of the stone pillar. A narrow stone staircase with a railing leads from the edge of the pond up to the shrine.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: The square pond is surrounded by a low brick railing decorated with glazed tiles, and green water lilies cover the water. The pagoda is part of the Dien Huu Pagoda complex, which has a traditional gate and a courtyard. A large Bodhi tree stands in the garden near the pagoda.

landmarks.name_vi: Văn Miếu - Quốc Tử Giám
landmarks.category: Di tích lịch sử & Giáo dục

visual_descriptions.overview: The Temple of Literature is a historic temple complex located in Dong Da district. The complex follows a long rectangular plan of five walled courtyards aligned on a central axis. The main entrance is Van Mieu Gate, a gate with three arched passages and a curved tiled roof.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Khue Van Cac, the Constellation of Literature Pavilion, is a two-storey pavilion with four square brick pillars supporting an upper wooden structure with round windows on each side and a tiled roof. Rows of stone stelae of doctors stand on the backs of stone turtles, sheltered under tiled roofs. Dai Thanh Shrine has a wide curved tiled roof, red lacquered wooden columns and gilded horizontal boards.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: The Well of Heavenly Clarity is a square pond surrounded by a stone railing, situated in front of Khue Van Cac. The courtyards are surrounded by old trees, lawns and brick walls. Visitors and graduating students in traditional dress walk along the stone paths between the gates.

landmarks.name_vi: Nhà hát Múa rối Thăng Long
landmarks.category: Nghệ thuật biểu diễn dân gian

visual_descriptions.overview: The Thang Long Water Puppetry Theatre is a performance building located on Dinh Tien Hoang street, near the northeastern shore of Hoan Kiem Lake. The facade has large posters and a ticket counter at the entrance, facing the lake.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Inside, the stage is a pool of water, and behind it stands a water pavilion with a curved tiled roof in the style of a traditional communal house. Bamboo screens hang across the front of the pavilion, hiding the puppeteers. The wooden puppets are carved and painted with bright lacquer in red, yellow and green colors.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: A live traditional music band with drums, bamboo flutes and a monochord sits on a platform beside the water stage. Puppets of dragons, phoenixes, farmers and fishermen move across the water surface under colorful stage lights, with smoke and water splashing.

landmarks.name_vi: Nhà Khách Chính Phủ (Bắc Bộ Phủ)
landmarks.category: Kiến trúc thuộc địa Pháp

visual_descriptions.overview: The Government Guest House is a large French colonial building located on Ngo Quyen street, near Hoan Kiem Lake. The building has a yellow facade with white decorative mouldings, tall windows with shutters and a tiled roof. It stands in a garden surrounded by old trees and a wrought iron fence.

landmarks.name_vi: Công viên Thống Nhất (Hồ Bảy Mẫu)
landmarks.category: Đại công viên đô thị

visual_descriptions.overview: Thong Nhat Park is a large urban park located in Hai Ba Trung district, with Bay Mau Lake in its center. Small islands in the lake are connected to the shore by bridges, and paved paths run under rows of tall trees. The park is surrounded by a fence and city streets, and Thien Quang Lake lies near its northern gate.

landmarks.name_vi: Công viên Thủ Lệ (Vườn thú Hà Nội)
landmarks.category: Công viên sinh thái & Vườn thú

visual_descriptions.overview: Thu Le Park is an ecological park and the Hanoi Zoo, located in Ba Dinh district. A large lake with an irregular shape lies at the center of the park, with small islands covered by trees. Paved paths, lawns and animal enclosures are surrounded by tall old trees.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Voi Phuc Temple is a traditional temple near the park entrance, with a curved tiled roof and a gate guarded by two kneeling stone elephant statues. Animal enclosures are made of metal fences, concrete walls and moats, and bridges cross narrow sections of the lake.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: Pedal boats float on the green water of the lake, and families walk along the shore. The park is surrounded by busy streets, with tall modern buildings visible above the trees.

landmarks.name_vi: Hồ Trúc Bạch
landmarks.category: Thắng cảnh hồ lịch sử

visual_descriptions.overview: Truc Bach Lake is a historic lake located in Ba Dinh district, separated from West Lake by Thanh Nien road. Swan-shaped pedal boats float on the water, and the lake is surrounded by trees and low-rise houses. A stone memorial on the shore marks the site where an American pilot was captured, and Quan Thanh Temple stands near the southern end of the lake.

landmarks.name_vi: Làng lụa Vạn Phúc (Hà Đông)
landmarks.category: Làng nghề truyền thống

visual_descriptions.overview: Van Phuc Silk Village is a traditional craft village located in Ha Dong district. The village gate is a traditional gate with a curved tiled roof and Chinese-style inscriptions, leading to a main street lined with silk shops. Bright silk fabrics in red, yellow, blue and purple colors hang in front of the shop windows.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Inside the workshops, wooden and mechanical looms weave silk, with rows of colored thread on spools. Van Phuc Communal House is a traditional communal house with a curved tiled roof, wooden columns and a stone courtyard, facing a small pond.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: One street in the village is decorated with hundreds of colorful umbrellas hanging overhead, creating a canopy of color above visitors walking below. Old brick houses with tiled roofs stand in the narrow alleys behind the shops.

landmarks.name_vi: Bảo tàng Dân tộc học Việt Nam
landmarks.category: Bảo tàng văn hóa dân tộc

visual_descriptions.overview: The Vietnam Museum of Ethnology is a museum located in Cau Giay district. The main exhibition building has a rounded form inspired by the Dong Son bronze drum. Behind it, an outdoor garden displays full-size traditional houses of ethnic groups, including a Bahnar communal house with a very tall steep thatched roof, an Ede longhouse on stilts and a Giarai tomb with carved wooden statues.

landmarks.name_vi: Bảo tàng Lịch sử Quốc gia
landmarks.category: Bảo tàng khảo cổ & Lịch sử

visual_descriptions.overview: The Vietnam National Museum of History is a museum located on Trang Tien street, near the Hanoi Opera House and the Red River. The main building has a yellow facade and an Indochinese architectural style that blends French and East Asian forms.
visual_descriptions.architecture: The central part of the building is an octagonal tower with a multi-tiered tiled roof, inspired by traditional pagoda roofs. The facade has deep verandas, tall windows with wooden shutters and decorative brackets under the eaves. The second building on Tran Quang Khai street has a French colonial architectural style.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: Inside, glass cases display bronze drums, stone statues, ceramics and ancient relics. The museum is surrounded by old trees and a quiet courtyard, with the second building located across the street.

landmarks.category: Nghệ thuật biểu diễn dân gian

visual_descriptions.overview: The Vietnam National Puppetry Theatre is a performance building located on Truong Chinh street. Inside, a water stage lies in front of a water pavilion with a curved tiled roof and bamboo screens. Colorful wooden puppets painted in red, yellow and green perform on the water surface, accompanied by a traditional music band.

landmarks.name_vi: Bảo tàng Phụ nữ Việt Nam
landmarks.category: Bảo tàng chuyên đề văn hóa

visual_descriptions.overview: The Vietnam Women's Museum is a modern museum located on Ly Thuong Kiem street in Hoan Kiem district. The building has a light-colored concrete and glass facade with clean geometric lines.
visual_descriptions.architecture: In the central atrium stands the Vietnamese Mother statue, a large statue with a golden color showing a woman holding her hands open. Natural light falls from above into the atrium, and spiral staircases and walkways connect the exhibition floors.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: Exhibition rooms display traditional costumes, textiles, jewelry and household artifacts of ethnic groups in glass cases. Colorful brocade fabrics in red, black and indigo colors hang on the walls.

landmarks.name_vi: Hồ Tây (Chùa Trấn Quốc - Phủ Tây Hồ)
landmarks.category: Quần thể danh thắng cảnh hồ

visual_descriptions.overview: West Lake is the largest lake in Hanoi, located in Tay Ho district. The wide water surface reflects the sky at sunset, and the lake is surrounded by trees, hotels and residential buildings. Swan-shaped pedal boats float near the shore.
visual_descriptions.architecture: Tran Quoc Pagoda is an ancient pagoda situated on a small island in the east of the lake, connected to Thanh Nien road by a short causeway. Its most visible part is a tall multi-tiered stupa with a red-brown color, with small statues set in arched niches on each tier. The pagoda has curved tiled roofs and is surrounded by old trees and a low railing.
visual_descriptions.surroundings: Tay Ho Palace is a temple situated on a small peninsula, with curved tiled roofs, red wooden gates and a courtyard facing the lake. Food stalls along the lane leading to the temple sell fried shrimp cakes. Thanh Nien road runs between West Lake and Truc Bach Lake.

landmarks.name_vi: Công viên Yên Sở (Gamuda City)
landmarks.category: Công viên sinh thái hiện đại

visual_descriptions.overview: Yen So Park is a large modern ecological park located in Hoang Mai district. Wide lakes with curved shorelines are surrounded by lawns, young trees and paved cycling paths. Modern bridges cross the water, and residential towers of the urban area are visible beyond the park.

need_verification: Có cầu bắc qua hồ trong công viên hay không [Cần Kiểm Tra]
